# Apk Signature Verification Patch **Turns off APK signature verification completely, so modified apps install directly.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Patches `framework.jar`, `services.jar` and optionally `miui-services.jar` on the device - No other module needed to install modified apps - Supports Android 16 and ColorOS ROMs - Works offline: all tools are bundled - To patch a JAR that isn't from your system, put it in `/sdcard/mods_center/` and flash the module ## Requirements - Android 13 or newer - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - If you only need modified system apps to load, [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) is the lighter option. ---
Made by **[🅺🅰🆂🅷🅸](https://t.me/kakashi1v1)** · part of **[Mods Center](https://github.com/Mods-Center)** [Website](https://modscenter.org) · [Channel](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs) · [Support group](https://t.me/bootloop_discussion) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/issues)

Apk Signature Verification Patch

Turns off APK signature verification completely, so modified apps install directly.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Patches `framework.jar`, `services.jar` and optionally `miui-services.jar` on the device
  • No other module needed to install modified apps
  • Supports Android 16 and ColorOS ROMs
  • Works offline: all tools are bundled
  • To patch a JAR that isn't from your system, put it in `/sdcard/mods_center/` and flash the module

    • Requirements

  • Android 13 or newer
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • If you only need modified system apps to load, [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) is the lighter option.

    • ---
